Job Summary

We are seeking a talented and passionate Python Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable applications and services. The ideal candidate will have strong Python programming skills, experience with modern development frameworks, and a solid understanding of software engineering best practices.


Key Responsibilities

  • Builds python automation for process in scope, Loans, KYC/AML workflow and hand-offs.
  • Supports integration with Copilot Studio agents
  • Support testing, tuning and deployment activities
  • Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality Python applications.
  • Build and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement technical solutions.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Integrate third-party APIs and external systems.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to software architecture decisions.


Required Qualifications:

  • Hands-on Python coding, Custom code, integrations, APIs, backend automation, Orchestration that extends the Power Platform ecosystem
  • Strong proficiency in Python and object-oriented programming concepts.
  • Knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.
  • Experience with Git and version control systems.
  • Understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and software design patterns.Familiarity with testing frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
